title: Corporate Financial Analyst (FP&A)
description: Seeking a Corporate Financial Analyst to support company-wide financial planning and analysis (FP&A), annual budgeting, strategic forecasting, and executive reporting.
responsibilities: Develop dynamic financial models, discounted cash flow (DCF) analyses, and forecasts.
Perform monthly P&L variance analysis comparing actual performance against budget.
Build financial presentations and executive summary decks for leadership.
Evaluate capital allocation, business unit performance, and strategic ROI opportunities.
requirements: 2+ years experience in corporate finance, investment banking, or FP&A.
Advanced Microsoft Excel modeling skills (macros, pivot tables, financial formulas).
Understanding of GAAP accounting standards and financial statement analysis.
Strong problem solving and business communication skills.
